content:
erin: Planning thread for launch sprint. Primary goal: accelerate first-success conversion with a combo of credit timing + prompt-template nudges. Deliverables: 1) 3 social posts (teaser, how-it-works gif, benchmark microclip), 2) webinar (Tue eve), 3) gated vs staggered credit experiment, 4) prompt sampler in onboarding.

samir: Proposal for credit variants (unique from prior runs): CONTROL = no credit; STAGGER = 400 on signup, +800 unlocked after first success within 7d; GATED = 300 on confirm, 1000 on first success. Ration: 30/40/30. Hypothesis: STAGGER reduces churn by keeping users engaged across steps.

clare: Love the stagger idea. Add an expiry window for staggered top-up (unlock window = 7 days) and a hard cap per org = 4500 credits. Also require idempotency for all grant hooks.

noah: Webinar flow: landing -> register -> immediate 200 credits on register for STAGGER only -> confirm email -> 30min reminder -> live. Attenders get +1200 and post-webinar prompt sampler package. No-shows get 300 if they watch recording within 72h. High-fit leads (intent_score >= 0.75 OR company_size >= 50) should be routed to SDR with payload containing variant and intent_score.

erin: We need to surface a short benchmark GIF (20s) for X showing latency + token-cost before/after warm-start caching + batching. Use headline: "3x cheaper, 40% faster for multi-turn demos" (only if numbers verified).

samir: Segment -> webhook plan pseudocode (keep simple):

```
variant = chooseVariant(user.id, ['CONTROL','STAGGER','GATED'])
analytics.identify(user.id, {launch_variant: variant})
if (variant == 'STAGGER') post('/hooks/credit-stagger', {user_id, amount:400, req_id})
else if (variant == 'GATED') await email_confirm -> post('/hooks/credit-gated', {user_id, amount:300, req_id})
```

clare: Important: include a dedupe key (req_id) and a server-side TTL for stagger unlock. Also track `credits_unlocked` event.

ops-bot: Staging hooks deployed: `/hooks/credit-stagger-v1`, `/hooks/credit-gated-v1`, `/hooks/sdr-route-v2`, `/hooks/promptpack-deliver-v3`. Test run IDs: sr_test_701, sr_test_702. Logs: https://ops.internal/tests/sr_test_701 :white_check_mark:

noah: On the prompt side: assemble a "prompt sampler" (3 short templates + 1 guided checklist) and include a CTA in the 1st onboarding email for STAGGER users — the CTA nudges them to make the first request to unlock top-up. Measure `sampler_opened` and `sampler_used`.

erin: Messaging asks: write 3 caption variants for X (punchy), 2 LI longreads (bench narrative + how-to), and a Product Hunt blurb that focuses on operational economics. Keep PH blurb under 120 words and include a call-to-action for the webinar.

samir: Analytics events: launch_variant_assign, launch_signup, email_confirm, credit_granted, credits_unlocked, first_success, sampler_opened, sampler_used, webinar_attend. Primary evaluation windows = 24h and 7d; secondary = retention@14d and spend_per_activation.

clare: Dashboards: need cohort breakdowns by variant, and token-cost-per-activation curves. Add a small chart comparing median latency pre/post warm-start. Noah -> can you own the dashboard spec?

noah: Yep. I'll wire events into BigQuery and produce a 24h/7d summary tile plus a burn-rate table for credits. Will include variant tag and utm_campaign fields.

erin: Ops check: can @ops-bot return a sample webhook payload for SDR routing so SDR knows how to parse intent_score + variant? Also we need a small privacy note in emails about credits being promotional and expiring.

ops-bot: SDR webhook sample payload: `POST /hooks/sdr-route-v2` body: { user_id, email, company_size, intent_score, launch_variant, request_id }. All hooks idempotent by request_id. Staging verification link: https://ops.internal/tests/sr_test_702/logs.

samir: A/B measurement plan: primary metric = first_success rate at 7d. We'll compare STAGGER vs GATED vs CONTROL with chi-squared and report lift + CI. Secondary metrics: tokens_used_in_7d, sampler_use_rate, retention@14d.

clare: Creative brief deadlines: captions + PH blurb + 20s benchmark GIF script by EOD tomorrow. Prompt sampler content by EOD today so QA can review. Noah -> dashboard spec by EOD. Ops-bot -> confirm prod hooks and provide smoke test IDs before EOD.

erin: Quick checklist of action owners: samir -> Segment rules + variant assignment; clare -> credit policy + legal blurb; noah -> dashboard + SDR payload spec; ops-bot -> deploy hooks + test logs; erin -> copy + social post schedule. Sync tomorrow 10am PT. :sparkles:
